Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent incorrectly assumed that Frank Lowy's birth date was confirmed solely based on Wikipedia without successfully verifying it through additional reputable non-Wikipedia sources. Although attempts were made to access Britannica and other sites, the failure to validate the birth date with at least two independent sources led to an incomplete solution. The initial error occurred when the WebSurfer did not provide a successful cross-verification of the birth date with non-Wikipedia sources.
